scope: Bounded key profile. Explicit refusal/legacy cases are intentional differences; other SQL shapes are unclassified. Complements issue 178, does not replace its isolation/protocol manifest.

contracts.description: NO PAD case/accent/combining distinctions, global uniqueness, NULLs, joins and keyset order
Exact large decimal comparison/group identity, scale-normalized index probes, signed/unsigned boundaries
Opaque binary values, zero bytes, uniqueness, byte length and stable index order
Settled lazy membership and order under explicit session catch-up, not eventual equivalence
Appended physical columns and new indexes preserve keys; incompatible changes refused
Legacy DATETIME spelling normalization control; temporal types refused by MYSQL key mode
Unsupported exact declarations and expressions refuse before effects and preserve prior transaction work
